description: This Java source file defines a helper class `TestSupportFactory` with methods for creating and setting up various domain objects and test data such as products, categories, countries, currencies, languages, stores, manufacturers, etc., primarily for testing purposes within a sales management application.

classes.name: TestSupportFactory
classes.description: A Spring component providing methods to generate and persist test data objects such as products, categories, countries, etc., for testing purposes in the sales management system.

methods.name: createAndStoreRandomProduct
methods.description: Creates a new product with random attributes, associated descriptions, availability, and price, then stores it into the database using the respective services.

methods.name: createCategory
methods.description: Creates a new category with descriptions in multiple languages, optionally as a child of a parent category.

methods.name: createCountry
methods.description: Creates a new country object with descriptions in a specified language.

methods.name: createCurrency
methods.description: Creates a new currency object based on the Canadian locale.

methods.name: createLanguage
methods.description: Creates a new language object with the given language code.

methods.name: createMerchantStore
methods.description: Creates a new merchant store with the specified name, country, currency, and language.

methods.name: createProductType
methods.description: Creates a new product type object with a general type code.

methods.name: createRandomManufacturer
methods.description: Creates a new manufacturer with a random name and description in the specified language.

methods.name: getRandomString
methods.description: Helper method that returns a random string from an array of strings.
